slides.texte_overlay:
Skills that make you
the most capable guy you know
Driving a manual car. It's useful abroad, in emergencies, and when someone else can't drive. A simple skill that makes you dependable.
Reading a map without your phone. Batteries die and signals drop. Knowing how to orient yourself makes you calm anywhere. Practise at a campsite.
Building a fire safely. Camping, a power cut, a cold night. Knowing how to make and control fire is an old skill that still matters.
Handling a difficult phone call. Complaining to a company, booking for a group, sorting a problem. Calm, clear calls get things done.
Before: I knew a little about very little. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and now I can talk about almost anything.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I knew a little about very little. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now I can talk about almost anything.

slides.texte_overlay: Basic self-defence. Not to fight, but to stay calm and protect yourself and others if you ever need to. Learn it once, use it forever.
Teaching others what you know. Explaining clearly and patiently makes you the person everyone comes to for help. Patience is a skill too, and people remember who helped them.
